plan.goal: Dose a compound at 1 mM working concentration from a 200 mM DMSO stock and report the resulting DMSO volume fraction.
plan.rationale: Working concentration 1 mM diluted from a 200 mM DMSO stock gives a DMSO volume fraction of 1/200 = 0.005 (0.5% v/v), which sits exactly at the 0.5% v/v solvent-toxicity guideline ceiling. A matched vehicle-only control at 0.5% DMSO is required to subtract solvent effects. Molecular weight is a placeholder (300 g/mol) and must be confirmed for the actual compound.
caveats: Confirm the stock is 200 mM in pure DMSO (not a diluted DMSO stock), otherwise the DMSO fraction changes.
0.5% v/v is at the solvent-toxicity ceiling; verify the cell line's DMSO tolerance (some primary cultures should stay <=0.1% v/v).
Run a matched vehicle-only control at 0.5% DMSO to subtract solvent effects.
